configuration.molecular_tokens: 24 separated tokens: 8 RNA, 8 CNA gain, 8 CNA loss; individual measured masks; newly trained encoder, no reused neural checkpoint
configuration.visual: frozen UNI2-h on unchanged audited CONCH footprints; patient total <=512; equal WSI weights; geometry-only QA
configuration.clinical: fold-local legal structured Clinical; not endpoint-derived; augmented constant one only inside compatibility factor
configuration.main_effect: joint linear Cox on C,S32,RNA512,CNA_gain8,CNA_loss8,UNImean_PCA32,RNAcoverage8,CNAcoverage8; convex ridge10 initialization; joint optimization of raw features, no scalar risk stacking
configuration.fixed_condition: [1, mean(C_fit)]; global CP intercept initialized one and trainable, so fixed-condition arm remains a nonzero rank4 bilinear model

arm_definitions.A0: ordinary bidirectional P-O attention; remove entire CP contribution
arm_definitions.A1: PAIRWISE_LOGIT_SUM: PO dot plus PC and OC lowrank pair scores; softmax can itself induce three-modal nonlinear dependence
arm_definitions.A2: CP with fixed training-mean clinical, retaining nonzero global lowrank bilinear factors
arm_definitions.A3: CP clinical-conditioned P-O score; same score also implemented as augmented Q/K for numerical equivalence, not a separate innovation baseline
arm_definitions.A4: same A3 trained and evaluated with partition-local wrong Clinical in interaction only; own main remains matched
arm_definitions.A5: same A3 trained and evaluated with partition-local wrong Omics in interaction only; own main remains matched
arm_definitions.A6: STRICT_PAIRWISE_RISK: separate PO, PC, OC scalar risks added linearly; no joint nonlinear post-fusion
arm_definitions.MGCT: pinned official-core Cox+Clinical adaptation; not native protocol reproduction
arm_definitions.CAMR_REPAIRED: pinned official-core vector-input Cox+Clinical adaptation with explicit source-level gate/adversary repairs; retained auxiliary objectives
arm_definitions.MMP: pinned official PANTHER/prototype and multimodal-core Cox+Clinical adaptation; training-only prototype fitting

training.selection: inner-validation full-risk Efron loss EMA only; fresh outer refit exact selected epochs; no architecture/hyperparameter winner selection across outer results
training.full_risk_gradient: one complete patient-risk computation with nonreentrant checkpoint preserving dropout RNG, then one exact Efron backward; never microbatch Cox or uncontrolled two-pass dropout

endpoints.secondary: PFI transfer of frozen DSS risks only; no PFI training or selection

engineering_gate.budget_failure: BUDGET_UNRESOLVED; do not declare mechanism no-go from censored optimization
engineering_gate.passing_direction_only: DIRECTIONAL_CANDIDATE, never confirmed without corrected intervals and independent cohort

configuration.scope: new attention architecture and separated tokenization; exploratory on repeatedly developed TCGA cohort; no SSM, no causal or first-formula claim
configuration.privacy: OOF, weights, raw matrices, patient and gene identifiers, permutations, prototype/PCA states and credentials private; only code and anonymous aggregate evidence public
configuration.after_matrix: diagnose actual failures; no automatic extra depth, rank search, endpoint switching or arbitrary scale search
